propositions: dc_store_copy_repo fixture hard-fails on git fetch origin tickets with exit status 128 and no diagnostic message because capture_output=True + check=True discards git stderr
git fetch, archive and ls-tree calls in the fixture use identical shape that raises CalledProcessError containing only exit status, not git's error reason
fetch is a single un-retried network call on the critical path, causing transient network errors to fail the entire test run as ERROR rather than gracefully retrying

diagnostic error handling must be fixed before retry policy is decidable, requiring a new helper that captures stderr and raises RuntimeError with verbatim git output plus remote, branch and exit status
fetch must retry transient failures a bounded small number of times with backoff before final failure, using policy of retry-then-fail not retry-then-skip
